name: Citizenship / Naturalization (Form N-400)

phases.name: Document Collection
documents: Copy of current/expired Green Card (front and back)
Tax returns (last 5 years, or 3 years if marriage-based)
Proof of payment or IRS agreement (if applicable)
Proof spouse is a U.S. citizen (if marriage-based)
Certified translations for all non-English documents
documents_pt: Cópia do Green Card atual/vencido (frente e verso)
Comprovante de endereço atual nos EUA
Declarações de imposto de renda (últimos 5 anos, ou 3 anos se baseado em casamento)
Comprovante de pagamento ou acordo com o IRS (se aplicável)
Comprovante de que o cônjuge é cidadão americano (se baseado em casamento)
Certidão de casamento (se baseado em casamento)
Traduções juramentadas de todos os documentos não em inglês
documents_es: Copia del Green Card actual/vencido (frente y reverso)
Comprobante de domicilio actual en EE. UU.
Actas de nacimiento de los hijos
Declaraciones de impuestos (últimos 5 años, o 3 años si es basado en matrimonio)
Comprobante de pago o acuerdo con el IRS (si aplica)
Comprobante de que el cónyuge es ciudadano estadounidense (si es basado en matrimonio)
Acta de matrimonio (si es basado en matrimonio)
Traducciones certificadas de todos los documentos que no estén en inglés
steps: Gather full list of trips (last 5 years): from/to (mm/dd/yyyy), city/state/country
Gather passport stamps and travel tickets/records
Gather proof of marital union for the last 3 years (joint bank accounts, lease/mortgage, insurance, joint tax returns, photos, children), if marriage-based

Gather 3-5 affidavits of good moral character (friends/family/employer/religious leader) -- each with full name, ID, address, relationship and length of time knowing the beneficiary, good-moral-character information

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Confirm all answers are consistent and complete
Confirm last 5 years are fully covered (no gaps)

phases.name: Execution
steps: Package order: Payment → Cover letter → G-1145 (optional) → Form N-400 → Supporting documents

phases.name: Finalization
steps: Interview documents prepared: Green Card (original), driver's license, all passports, travel records, tax returns (3-5 years), marriage documents (if applicable), name-change documents (if applicable)
